name: Microsoft 365 / Office 365 (Click-to-Run)
summary: Does NOT install through Wine: the Click-to-Run online installer and Microsoft-account sign-in need Windows components Wine lacks.
notes:
Microsoft 365 (the subscription 'Office 365' apps) cannot be installed through Wine or Proton on Lindos or any other Linux. The Click-to-Run installer (OfficeSetup.exe / setup.exe from office.com) uses a virtualised app layer (AppV) and Windows Update-style streaming that Wine does not implement, and the apps require signing in with a Microsoft account through WebView2/Edge components that do not work either. Older builds that people managed to install stop working at the first update.
What does work: an Office 2016/2019/2021 32-bit offline installer activated with a product key (see recipe 'office-2016'), and the alternatives below - all of them open and save .docx/.xlsx/.pptx.
If you only need your Microsoft 365 subscription: use Office for the web at https://www.office.com in Edge/Chrome/Firefox (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneDrive, Teams) - it is included in the subscription and works fully on Lindos.

alternatives.name: LibreOffice
alternatives.how: already installed on Lindos: Start Menu > Office (Writer, Calc, Impress) - opens/saves Office formats

alternatives.name: OnlyOffice Desktop Editors
alternatives.how: native, closest to the Office look and best .docx fidelity: Flatpak org.onlyoffice.desktopeditors or Lindos Settings > Apps > Store

alternatives.name: Office for the web (office.com)
alternatives.how: your Microsoft 365 subscription in the browser: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneDrive, Teams

alternatives.name: Office 2016 offline installer
alternatives.how: runs through Wine with a product key: lindos-compat recipes apply office-2016
